experiments.title: Study of D/A Conversion Using Binary Weighted Resistor And Measurement Of Its  Resolution

blocks.text: To study 8 bit Digital to Analog Conversion using Binary Weighted Resistors Method and measures its resolution.

Digital to Analog Conversion involve conversion of Digital signal to Analog signal. It is an integral part of any A/D converter. This can be easily accomplished by designing  a resistive network that will change each digital level into an equivalent  binary weighted voltage. There are two methods by which we can do this process. First method is using binary weighted resistor method. In this method the binary coded decimal code is used for the representation of the decimal number. The LSB which is at right most location is expressed as (1 or 0)*2^0, the next bit is 1 or 0*21 and so on, where 0 indicates 0V and 1 indicates 5V). Thus the weight of each column from right to left in n bit converter are 1,2,4,8………2n-1.

Following criteria can be applied to this divider. 
* There must be one input resistor for each digital bit. 
* Beginning with the LSB, each following resistor value is one half of the size of the previous resistor. 
* The full scale output voltage is equal to the positive voltage of the digital I/P signal. 
* The LSB has a weight of 1/ (2n-1),where n is the number of input bits. 
* The change in output voltage due change in LSB is equal to the V/ (2n-1), where V is the digital input voltage level. 
* The output voltage can be found for any digital input signal by using the following modified form of Mill man’s
   theorem. (Image-1&2).
RESOLUTION:- 
Resolution indicates the smallest increment of the output corresponding to a 1 LSB input 
code change. For example for 8 bit DAC, 28= 256 codes, so the resolution is 1/256 of the 
output range.

* Give the desired logic input to the 8 BIT BINARY WEIGHTED DACfrom on board slider switches as shown below in
   FIGURE-1.1 
* Measure the equivalent output voltage at VOUT of 8 BIT BINARY WEIGHTED DAC for different digital input voltage 
   level with the help of DMM. 
* Observed the calculated and observed readings for different input levels.

RESOLUTION:- 
Resolution of 8 bit converter can be calculated by using formula 
= (1/2N) ×Vref=0.019V 
Calculated Value of Resolution= (1/28) ×5=0.019V 
For observed value subtract any consecutive observed reading like 0.042-0.021=0.021V, this will give observed Value of Resolution.
The analog output voltage can be found for any digital input signal by using the binary weighted resister network and its resolution for 8 bits  is 0.019V(LSB).

experiments.title: Study of D/A conversion using R/2R ladder type method and measurement of its  resolution

blocks.text: To study 8 bit Digital to Analog Conversion using R/2R Ladder type Method and measure its resolution.

Binary R/2R Ladder is a resistive network whose output voltage is properly weighted sum of the Digital input.  

It is constructed of resistors that have only two values. We can see from the FIGURE-2.1 that total resistance looking from any node back towards the terminating resistor or out towards the digital input is 2R. We can use the resistance characteristics of the ladder to determine the output voltage for the various digital inputs. Ladder is composed of linear resistors, it is a linear network and the principle of superposition can be used. This means that the output voltage due to combination of input digital level can be found by simply taking the sum of the output levels caused by each digital input individually. To keep the ladder in perfect balance and to maintain symmetry, the output of ladder should be terminated in a resistance of 2R.This will result in lowering of output voltage, but if the 2R load is maintained constant, the output voltage will still be a properly weighted sum of binary input bits. If load is varied, the output voltage will not be a properly weighted sum hence load should be kept constant.

1) Connect the trainer kit with its power supply. 
2) Give the desired logic input to the converter from on board slider switches  of 8 BIT R/2R LADDER  DAC SECTION   
     as shown below in FIGURE-2.1 
3) Measure the equivalent output voltage for different digital input voltage level with the help of DMM at VOUT of 8   
     BIT R/2R LADDER DAC. 
4) Observed the calculated and observed readings for different input levels.

RESOLUTION 
Resolution of 8 bit converter can be calculated by  
Formula = (1/2N) ×Vref=0.019V 
Calculated Value of Resolution= (1/28) ×5=0.019V. 
For observed value subtract any consecutive observed reading like 0.0388
0.0186=0.020V.This will give observed Value of Resolution.
